name: Vibrant Zest-Core
description: Upon use, increases all allies' Elation by 24% for the next battle.
story:
At first, no one paid any attention to this orange can... until it started jumping, singing, and showering all of Planarcadia with joyful dopamine. Watch out! If it catches you frowning, it'll send little orange fairies bursting into your mouth to do a cheerful tap dance on the tip of your tongue.

"Note: No imagenae were harmed during this delivery event."
